description: This file is an implementation of a generic service layer in Java for entity management, providing CRUD operations and entity retrieval methods using a DAO pattern. It is part of a sales management codebase, with a focus on handling generic entities.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl
classes.description: An abstract class implementing generic CRUD and retrieval operations for entities, parameterized by entity type and ID type, utilizing a DAO for database interactions.

methods.name: SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DAO and determining the entity class type using reflection utilities.

methods.name: getObjectClass
methods.description: Returns the runtime class of the entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity instance by its class and ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an entity instance by its ID.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves an entity based on a specified field and value.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity, handling exceptions via ServiceException.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity by delegating to createEntity.

methods.name: createEntity
methods.description: Protected method to save an entity, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Protected method to update an entity.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of the entity from the database.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all entities.

methods.name: listByField
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entities matching a specific field value.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of entities.
